seller: existing shareholders including promoters Akuri Srinivasa Reddy and A. Sandhya

sources.title: Technopaints And Chemicals Submits DRHP For Proposed IPO, Plans To Raise As Much As ₹500 Crore

synopsis: Technopaints and Chemicals Ltd has submitted a draft red herring prospectus with Sebi for an initial public offering aiming to raise up to Rs 500 crore. The proposed IPO consists of a Rs 325 crore fresh issue and a Rs 175 crore offer for sale by existing shareholders. Promoters Akuri Srinivasa Reddy and A. Sandhya plan to sell shares worth up to Rs 90 crore and Rs 30 crore, respectively, alongside other promoter group members and individual shareholders. Anand Rathi Advisors acts as the book-running lead manager and KFin Technologies is the registrar. The company intends to list its shares on the NSE and BSE.
